standard_prerequisites.name: The pairing given by the degree map is perfect
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Axiom (A) describing the nondegenerate pairing between complementary cohomology groups through the degree map
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows replacing the equality of degree pairings by the equality of the classes involved.

standard_prerequisites.name: Pullback is compatible with the degree map
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Axiom (A)(b) together with the compatibility of pullback with the pairing, so that the degree of a pullback is the degree of the original class
standard_prerequisites.use: Moves pullbacks across the degree sums in the two displayed computations.

core_obligations: Projection formula (proof lines 1607-1613): pair both sides of the asserted identity with an arbitrary class and use compatibility of pullback with the degree map twice, so that the pairing of the left hand side with the class becomes the pairing of the right hand side; nondegeneracy of the pairing then gives the equality.

Composition of pushforwards (proof lines 1613-1624): pairing the two sides with an arbitrary class and applying compatibility of pullback with the degree map repeatedly reduces the assertion to the identity of pullback along a composite, which is immediate; nondegeneracy gives the equality of the two pushforwards.
proof_roadmap: Pair the projection formula with an arbitrary class and use compatibility of pullback with the degree sum.
Pair the composition identity with an arbitrary class and reduce to the functoriality of pullback.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the projection formula and the compatibility of pushforward with composition for a classical Weil cohomology theory (statement lines 1603-1608). The proof (proof lines 1609-1624) pairs both assertions with an arbitrary class, uses the compatibility of pullback with the degree map, and concludes by nondegeneracy of the pairing. H2: a complete short computation whose two displayed substitutions are checkable by the reader.
